description: Truck routes is a dataset listed in City of Vancouver Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Vancouver. This dataset indicates where designated truck routes exist in the City. Data currency This data does not change often. Data accuracy Truck routes generally follow street centrelines; centrelines are in the approximate centre of streets. Coverage: Vancouver. The portal files it under Streets and transportation. Its keywords are traffic. The portal shows 2 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-03-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Vancouver (https://opendata.vancouver.ca/pages/licence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-vancouver-ca-portal.
